attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Hawaii state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per HRS § 235-51: tax = max(AGI - filing-status std ded, 0) x 11%. Standard deductions: $2,200 Single/MFS, $4,400 MFJ/QSS, $3,212 HOH. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.computed_state_tax = 0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = 0; add " Hawaii Tax Calculation (top marginal 11.0%)" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Hawaii Tax Calculation (top marginal 11%)" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 4400.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.11
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 4400.0 f- 0.0 fmax /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.11 f* /result.computed_state_tax xdef " HI MFJ taxable income (AGI - $4,400): $" result.computed_state_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " HI state tax (11%): $" result.computed_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 3212.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.11
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 3212.0 f- 0.0 fmax /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.11 f* /result.computed_state_tax xdef " HI HOH taxable income (AGI - $3,212): $" result.computed_state_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " HI state tax (11%): $" result.computed_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 2200.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.11
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 2200.0 f- 0.0 fmax /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.11 f* /result.computed_state_tax xdef " HI Single/MFS taxable income (AGI - $2,200): $" result.computed_state_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " HI state tax (11%): $" result.computed_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

policy_statement.policy_description: HI MFJ: 11% x max(AGI - $4,400, 0) per HRS § 235-51
HI HOH: 11% x max(AGI - $3,212, 0) per HRS § 235-51
HI Single/MFS: 11% x max(AGI - $2,200, 0) per HRS § 235-51
